title: German nuclear tests seen over the Baltic

tellings.quote: Um, there are some eyewitness reports of two German nuclear weapons tests being conducted between late 1944 and early 1945.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, says there are eyewitness reports of two German nuclear weapons tests in late 1944 and early 1945, in the Baltic Sea area between Sweden and Finland. If true, Nazi Germany would have tested atomic weapons before the war ended.
